text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As I'm about to have lunch, I suddenly
hear a very
loud voice.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: No, I don't wannaaa! Nuh-uh, nuh-uh! I won't eat my veggies, and you can't make me!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear... How should I deal with this
naughty
witch?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I've noticed that you never eat your
vegetables,
whether here or at the
dorms... As your dorm
leader, I worry
that you're not getting enough
vitamins
and minerals.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hmph! Green bell peppers and onions
are the
sworn enemy of all witches! I
don't care what you
say, I'm not eating
them!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Sworn enemies, you say? Why yes, I
think I've
read a book on this matter
before.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Its passages spoke of how witches are
familiar
with all manner of plants,
including flowers and
vegetables.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Sounds to me like a great witch would
be in good
tidings with green bell
peppers and onions, don't
you think?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Huh? Oh, uh...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Why, this could be an opportunity for
you. Surely
acquainting yourself with
these veggies will bring
you one step
closer to becoming a great witch.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: W-well... Urrrgh!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sweep Tosho's eyes dart around in
search of help,
eventually locking with
mine.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
That's it! Hey, you! You tell me what I
should do!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Wh-why would you say thaaat?!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Excellent. Let us begin with the green
bell
peppers. "Fair witch, will you be my
friend?"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh, I'll do it, okay?! Just so... I can
become a
great witch!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Munch, munch... Gulp.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Blergh! It's sooo bitter! I knew I shouldn't
have
eaten it!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Vegetables are supposed to be used for
magical
potions and stuff! Why would a
witch need to be
friends with them?
That doesn't make sense!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Yuck, yuck, yuck! I can't get the taste
out of my
mouuuuth! WAAAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... I guess this is where the real
battle
begins.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I'll bring you some juice, so please...
quiet down.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, good choice! You know exactly
what to
say! ♪

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I've made up my mind—no veggies for
Sweepy!
Why be friends with them when
I can have my way
with magic!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Here's what I'll do with them...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: I'll do this! And even this!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Ah... Stop that!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Wah?! Where'd these... v-vegetables
come from?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Hehe! That solves everything! ♪ See ya!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sweep Tosho makes a run for it after
pushing her
vegetables onto Kawakami
Princess's plate.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki and Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Come back this instant! Hey, get back
here!
